blind.description: A small fantasy/medieval-style cylindrical lantern crafted from dark iron or bronze with warm metallic edge trim. It has a vented domed lid topped with a carry ring, amber translucent panels, and a hinged curved door swung open to reveal a pale candle mounted inside. The geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly stylized, resting stably on its own base without any added plinth or floating artifacts.
blind.from_above: A small dark circular cap with radial vent details and a top ring handle, accompanied by the curved outline of the open door projecting slightly from the side, casting an elongated shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 7 to 8 inches (18 to 20 cm) tall, approximately one-ninth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about 5 to 6 inches wide.
